excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Phase One — Chesed: UI/API Possibility Map The Awtsmoos renews every screen from nothing, yet no screen should pretend to own its neighbor's skin; Awtsmoos.com may glow with futuristic motion only when each local vessel knows exactly where it must begin. Ideal product surface Every route
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase one — chesed: ui/api possibility map the awtsmoos renews every screen from nothing, yet no screen should pretend to own its neighbor's skin; awtsmoos.com may glow with futuristic motion only when each local vessel knows exactly where it must begin. ideal product surface every route has exactly one explicit style authority root. shared design systems are opt in, never implicit global resets. every interactive element has complete hover capable, active, focus visible, disabled, busy, invalid, selected/current/expanded states as applicable. advanced tools retract into native or accessible disclosures instead of crowding first paint. mobile is the base layout; wide screens progressively reveal secondary navigation and inspectors. every panel owns a local z index scale and clipping/overflow policy. motion communicates hierarchy, success, disclosure, loading, and focus without decorative noise. reduced motion and forced colors preserve the whole workflow, not merely stop animations. form autofill looks intentional instead of browser injected. empty/loading/error/authenticated/signed out states remain visually distinct. route families may share tokens, but not unscoped selectors. page scripts use abortable lifecycle controllers and explicit state machines instead of anonymous listener accumulation. network/api access flows through request/result objects with normalized loading/error/auth/retry semantics. data descriptors feed renderers; dom code should not own application truth. jsdoc stays expansive and descriptive; file budgets are solved with more modules. immediate reference family authentication is the first reference because it is small, public, mobile sensitive, security adjacent, and currently demonstrates real selector leakage. once its contract is green, the same sovereignty tests can be generalized to other style families. next action complete the auth family as the first provably root scoped design system slice.

excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Phase Two — Gevurah: Conflict and Failure Map The Awtsmoos renews every border, focus ring, panel, and path; Awtsmoos.com needs disciplined Gevurah so one beautiful page never becomes another page's wrath. Confirmed risks 1. Auth token ownership currently leaks through :root. 2. Auth bas
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — gevurah: conflict and failure map the awtsmoos renews every border, focus ring, panel, and path; awtsmoos.com needs disciplined gevurah so one beautiful page never becomes another page's wrath. confirmed risks 1. auth token ownership currently leaks through :root. 2. auth base styles currently reset raw , html, body, and bh. 3. auth typography currently owns raw h1, h2 selectors. 4. auth fields currently style raw form alongside .login form. 5. auth reduced motion rules currently target every element globally. 6. hover transforms run on touch devices unless capability gated. 7. autofill lacks an explicit theme contract. 8. readonly/disabled field state styling is incomplete. 9. busy submit state does not expose a distinct visual affordance beyond opacity/filter. 10. focus ownership exists mainly on actions, not every possible linked/field surface. 11. several independent design systems exist; importing them together without route ownership can produce cascade collisions. 12. future system adoption is sparse; it must not be injected globally as a shortcut. 13. route inventory includes archived transfer copies that must not be treated as production pages. 14. many game/app subtrees have concurrent changes; whole file rewrites require fresh ownership checks. 15. arbitrary high z index values across legacy apps may conflict with shell/modal/drawer layers. 16. fixed width toolbars and editors can overflow narrow screens. 17. absolute/fixed surfaces may ignore safe area insets. 18. generic css resets may override browser accessibility in forced colors mode. 19. decorative animation can interfere with reduced motion unless scoped. 20. touch hover emulation can leave controls in sticky visual states. 21. dom scripts may register listeners repeatedly without abortsignal ownership. 22. page fetch logic may conflate network failure, http failure, authentication failure, and empty data. 23. large js files can tempt documentation deletion; this is forbidden—responsibility extraction is required. 24. server template helpers may be duplicated because template blocks have separate execution scope; do not refactor until runtime semantics are verified. 25. ui improvement must preserve auth/session/security behavior and never leak credentials or tokens into client visible state. chosen first correction use .login page as the sole auth style root because both login and register already carry it, including server generated message pages. no html change is required for css sovereignty. rewrite all auth css modules around that existing root; then expand the auth contract test to reject unscoped selectors and ungated hover. next action fresh status check auth css, then perform whole file localized rewrites and run the auth css contract.
